title: Memoryfield §7 — Export / import
description: /export-memoryfield [folders…] [--out name.memoryfield.zip]: map frontmatter (title, created, updated, summary, uuid written back to source), split >8k notes at ## into '(1 of N)' pages, move CaB-specific keys into x-cab namespace, zip, print sha256. /import-memoryfield <zip>: verify sha256 or warn loudly, never auto-trust; pages get source: external, confidence: low, tag imported, folder listed under CLAUDE.md retrieval.quarantine so /ask labels them (imported, unverified). Conform to Paterson's SPEC.md, fetched at implementation time. Acceptance: round-trip export Resources/, import into a scratch vault, /ask answers with correct citation and the (imported, unverified) label.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Memoryfield Improvements Spec]] — §7. No index dependency. First target (soapstones zip) dropped by Don on 2026-09-02.
close_reason: Implemented: .claude/scripts/memoryfield.py (export/import), /export-memoryfield and /import-memoryfield commands, (imported, unverified) label rule in /ask, retrieval.quarantine block in CLAUDE.md. Verified against Paterson SPEC.md v0.1: flat zip, slug filenames, quoted ISO datetimes, 8192-byte split at ## with fresh uuids, index.md without catalogue, listing.md. Tested: uuid write-back, 3-way split, bare note, sha256 refusal on mismatch, loud warning without hash, quarantine append. Not done: no vector index (Phase D), /ask acceptance is a prompt-level behavior not runnable headless; soapstones target dropped by Don.

title: Temporal retrieval — Phase A: index + scoring, grep only
description: Schema for .index/brain.sqlite3, /reindex, note_type inference, recency scoring, /ask rerank + age labels. No ollama. Acceptance: '/ask what's going on with <active area>' ranks this week's notes above last month's with equal grep hits.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Temporal Retrieval Spec]] — Part 1, Part 2 (relevance + recency), Part 7 (/reindex, /ask), Phase A
close_reason: Implemented: .claude/scripts/brain_index.py (reindex / rank / show) with the spec's notes + retrievals schema, note_type inference (folder, frontmatter override for known types), created/updated from frontmatter → git → mtime with a rule so bulk-committed notes keep their own date, grep relevance (hit density normalized + 0.3 title/summary bonus), recency 2^(-age/half_life) with CLAUDE.md overrides and project-only-when-complete decay, activation neutral until Phase B writes retrievals. /reindex command; /ask Step 0 ranks with the index and cites with (Nd old · last cited · refs) labels and [possibly stale]; /weekly-review runs /reindex. Acceptance passed in a scratch vault: equal-hit Days notes, 1d vs 28d, 0.80 vs ~0.00 under 'current'; equal under 'archival'. Not done: profile classification (Phase C), bumps (Phase B), embeddings (Phase D).

title: Temporal Retrieval Spec
description: Umbrella for temporal retrieval Phases A–E. Dependencies A→B→C, A→D, B→E.

title: Memoryfield Improvements Spec
description: Umbrella for the seven memoryfield improvements. Build order: §7 → §2 → §6 → §4 → §5 → §3. §1 is owned by the Temporal spec.

title: Revisit annual-only pricing for mid-market
description: Two mid-market accounts pushed back on annual-only during renewal conversations. The cash-flow rationale behind the original decision may no longer hold.
notes: Opened after the Riverside renewal call. The original decision (cab-ex1) was explicitly conditional on churn staying flat. Evidence has accumulated twice since and the decision has not been formally reopened. Source: [[Areas/Pricing]]

title: Annual-only billing for enterprise tier
description: Enterprise contracts move to annual-only billing. Quarterly remains available for mid-market and below.
notes: Rationale: cash flow predictability through H2. Dana drove it. Rejected quarterly-for-all — billing overhead and revenue recognition complexity. Marcus flagged mid-market risk at the time; noted, not blocking. Explicitly conditional: revisit if churn moves. Source: [[Meetings/20250312 - Pricing Review]]

title: Memoryfield §2 — Provenance and confidence in frontmatter
description: source: human|inferred|external|mixed and optional confidence in frontmatter; ^human / ^inferred inline markers for mixed notes; templates carry source: by default; /save-to-brain and /process-meeting set it. /ask labels citations (human)/(inferred)/(external, unverified), applies 1.0/0.85/0.7 relevance multiplier, never restates an inferred claim as fact. Acceptance: '/ask why did we go annual-only' on the seed distinguishes Dana's stated position from Claude-authored rationale.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Memoryfield Improvements Spec]] — §2. Template and command changes only.
close_reason: Implemented: source: on every template (human for Area/Daily/Person/Project, mixed for Meeting/Weekly Review/MOC), ^inferred/^human inline markers documented in CLAUDE.md Conventions and Templates/README; /save-to-brain sets source per what it saves; /process-meeting sets mixed and marks inferences; /ask labels citations (human)/(inferred)/(mixed)/(external, unverified) and never restates an inference as fact; index stores source/confidence and applies 1.0/0.95/0.85/0.7 to relevance (mixed=0.95 is an interpretation; spec left it unspecified). Seed notes tagged. Acceptance ('/ask why did we go annual-only') is prompt-level; rank output verified to carry the labels.

title: Memoryfield §6 — Citations as a first-class field, with /verify
description: sources: list in frontmatter (url, fetched, optional claim). /save-to-brain populates it for fetched pages. /verify [path | --stale N]: refetch, ask a reader whether the page still supports each claim, update fetched, append '⚠ verify failed <date>' and file a contradiction bead on failure. ≤30 fetches per run; skip CLAUDE.md verify.skip_domains. Acceptance: a deliberately wrong claim gets flagged.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Memoryfield Improvements Spec]] — §6. Depends on §2 for source: external.
close_reason: Implemented: sources: frontmatter (url, fetched, claim) documented in CLAUDE.md and /save-to-brain; /verify command + .claude/scripts/verify_sources.py (list with --stale and 30-fetch cap, fetch with --grep excerpts, mark --ok/--failed with ⚠ verify failed <date>, --index for shared URLs); skip_domains + max_fetches in CLAUDE.md retrieval.verify; contradiction bead reuses §3's label. Acceptance: a deliberately wrong claim ('spec carries a format version') against Paterson's live SPEC.md fetched the contradicting passage ('intentionally don't carry a format version') and was marked failed; the reader's judgment is Claude's in the command.

title: Temporal retrieval — Phase D: embeddings (ollama + nomic-embed-text)
description: Detect ollama + nomic-embed-text at /reindex, embed bodies (8k cap, truncated warning), hybrid retrieval unioning semantic and grep candidates. Acceptance: a note whose title does not mention the query term is found by /ask when its body clearly matches.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Temporal Retrieval Spec]] — Part 1 (embeddings), Part 2 (hybrid relevance), Phase D

title: Temporal retrieval — Phase B: retrieval bumps + activation
description: retrievals table, bump logic on read-for-answer and new inbound wikilinks, ACT-R base-level activation normalized 0.5–1.5. Acceptance: cite a 60-day-old meeting note three times via /ask; it then outranks a 10-day-old note with equal relevance.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Temporal Retrieval Spec]] — Part 2 (activation), Part 4, Phase B. Open question to raise, not decide: should wikilink ref_count weigh 0.5× retrieval-for-answer?

title: Memoryfield §3 — Contradiction detection as a maintenance pass
description: In /weekly-review after extraction: for each note updated this week, top-5 neighbors (embeddings, or shared wikilinks + tag overlap without them); a reader answers yes/no with quotes; each conflict becomes 'bd create "Possible contradiction: <topic>" --labels contradiction'. Cap 20 pairs, prefer state-shaped older notes, never re-file an existing pair. Acceptance: the Apr 18 seed note triggers a contradiction bead against the Mar 12 pricing decision without /thread.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Memoryfield Improvements Spec]] — §3. Blocked on Temporal Phase A for the degraded (wikilink/tag) neighbor mode; Phase D embeddings make neighbors good but are not required. Decision 2026-09-02: hard-block on A, relate to D.

title: Memoryfield §5 — Auto-promotion between layers
description: Mechanical proposals, never actions: same fact in ≥3 notes → bd remember; memory subject in an open bead → link; Resources note cited ≥5× in 30 days → MOC or memory; Inbox item >14 days → propose route. /save-to-brain checks the first pattern; /weekly-review runs the full table after extraction. Accepted promotions logged in Knowledge Changelog.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Memoryfield Improvements Spec]] — §5. Depends on Temporal Phase A (index for near-dup detection); fuzzy-match fallback without embeddings. Runs after Temporal Phase E extraction in the same weekly pass.

title: Memoryfield §4 — Memory decay for beads memories
description: Track confirmed date and ttl per memory. Checked 2026-09-02 on bd 1.2.2: 'bd remember' has no metadata flag (only --key), so the spec's fallback applies: a committed .beads/memory-meta.jsonl sidecar keyed by memory key. Needs a .gitignore exception because .beads/* is ignored. /brief gains 'Memories to confirm' (today − confirmed > ttl; confirm / retire / edit; cap 5, oldest first). Defaults: ttl 90, people 60, tag permanent never surfaces. No decay applied to injection. Acceptance: a memory with ttl=1 appears in /brief's confirm list the next day.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Memoryfield Improvements Spec]] — §4. The 'check beads metadata support' dependency is resolved: not supported, use the sidecar.
close_reason: Implemented: bd 1.2.2 has no memory metadata, so .beads/memory-meta.jsonl (committed; .gitignore exception) keyed by memory key holds confirmed/ttl/kind/permanent. .claude/scripts/memory_meta.py: confirm (ttl 90, --kind person 60, --permanent), due (oldest first, cap 5, seeds untracked memories as confirmed today), retire (bd forget + drop), list. /brief gains 'Memories to confirm' with confirm/retire/edit; Beads Guide, CLAUDE.md, /capture, /save-to-brain, /install tell you to confirm after bd remember. No decay applied to injection. Acceptance: ttl=1 memory surfaced under a faked date two days later.

title: Temporal retrieval — Phase E: extraction in /weekly-review
description: Distillation replaces summary notes: decisions → Areas ## Decisions, stable facts → bd remember, commitments → beads, references → Resources. Write distilled_to / distilled_on to source frontmatter. /brief gains a 'Cooling off' section. Acceptance: on the example-seed pricing thread, the Apr 18 cash-position observation lands in Areas/Pricing.md with a dated link back.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Temporal Retrieval Spec]] — Part 5, Part 6, Part 7 (/brief, /weekly-review, /link-check), Phase E

title: Temporal retrieval — Phase C: query intent profiles
description: Classify /ask questions into current / decision / archival with half-life multipliers. /thread forces archival; /prep mixes. Acceptance: 'has anyone ever mentioned X' surfaces a 6-month-old note that '/ask what's going on with X' does not.
notes: Source: [[Projects/Temporal Retrieval Spec]] — Part 3, Phase C. Open question to raise, not decide: does the classifier live as a prompt block inside /ask or a tiny agent in inline mode?
